articles.title: State Fuel Retailers Lost ₹74,781 Cr in Q1, Says Oil Minister Puri
articles.titleEn: State Fuel Retailers Lost ₹74,781 Cr in Q1, Says Oil Minister Puri
articles.summary: State-run oil marketing companies in India suffered losses of ₹74,781 crore in April–June by selling fuel below market rates, even as Brent crude prices fall. Oil minister Hardeep Singh Puri remains noncommittal on cutting petrol and diesel prices, saying refiners are still processing higher-priced crude. Read how losses, global price trends, and private refiners like Nayara Energy could shape future fuel prices.
